answer: In PoA, trust propagates through bounded-length random walks on the attestation graph: a verifier’s mass is mixed for only T steps, so an adversarial sybil cluster gains weight chiefly through its boundary. If that set has conductance φ near the nadir, its escape probability is at most Tφ, while min-cut transitivity bounds cap its aggregate voting weight; repeated attestations add echo, not independent trust, preserving resistance throughout the network’s voyage.
